jobs.title: Landscape Architect
jobs.description:
**Help us create places people are proud to call home.**


We’re looking for a talented **Landscape Architect** to join Hill and help shape the landscape, public realm and placemaking across our residential and mixed\-use developments.


Working across projects from **early concept and planning through to detailed design and delivery**, you’ll collaborate with our Land, Planning, Technical, Development and Construction teams to create high\-quality, sustainable and distinctive places.

### **What you’ll be doing**

* Providing landscape design input across new and live developments
* Supporting site layouts, masterplans and placemaking strategies
* Reviewing and coordinating all landscape designs
* Creating and developing hard and soft landscape proposals
* Supporting planning applications and landscape conditions
* Integrating **Biodiversity Net Gain, SuDS and green infrastructure**
* Working with multidisciplinary teams to ensure designs are practical, coordinated and deliverable
* Visiting sites to help maintain landscape quality through construction

### **What we’re looking for**

* Degree or postgraduate qualification in **Landscape Architecture**
* Experience within a landscape practice, developer, housebuilder or multidisciplinary environment
* Good understanding of the **UK planning system**
* Knowledge of BNG, sustainable drainage and green infrastructure
* Strong design skills with a practical and commercially aware approach
* Experience taking projects from concept and planning through to delivery

**What you’ll get:**

* 26 days holiday
* Private healthcare and wellbeing platform
* Hill Incentive scheme and retail discounts
* Volunteering days and continuous learning opportunities
* A high\-performing and supportive team culture
* competitive salary and package

**Why Hill?**


At Hill, we offer more than just a job — we offer the opportunity to make a real and lasting impact. Every person here contributes to delivering sustainable, high\-quality homes and shaping vibrant communities across the UK.


Our culture is underpinned by our values:

* **Ambition** – we set bold goals and support each other to exceed them
* **Impact** – we focus on delivering meaningful outcomes
* **Agility** – we move quickly, adapt confidently, and embrace change
* **Collaboration** – we work together to achieve more, sharing success along the way


As a privately owned business, we’re able to move with pace and purpose. We invest in people, support career growth, and empower individuals to lead from wherever they stand. Hard\-working, driven people thrive here — and are recognised for what they deliver and how they deliver it.


Join Hill and be part of a forward\-thinking, values\-led team. Together, we’re not just building homes — we’re building a lasting legacy.


We are proud to be a **Disability Confident Employer**. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and can provide adjustments throughout the recruitment process.


This is a great opportunity to influence landscape design across Hill’s developments and help us create **distinctive, sustainable places with a lasting legacy**.

Part of Wacoal Europe Group, Bravissimo is an award\-winning, multi\-channel lingerie retailer on a mission to uplift women. Since 1995, our purpose has stayed the same: to inspire our customers to feel supported, celebrated, and confident every day.


We have 26 shops in the UK alongside a thriving ecommerce community, which offers a wide range of beautiful lingerie, swimwear and nightwear for women who wear a D to L cup, giving them so much choice.


We are on an exciting journey of growth and are loving every minute of it!

We're looking for a mid\-level Software Engineer to join our Back of House engineering team and help build, support and evolve a range of business\-critical applications. Working across a range of Bravissimo applications, you'll develop APIs, backend services and event\-driven solutions that support key business areas including product management, customer acquisition, ordering and fulfilment.


Bravissimo is in the middle of a major digital transformation programme, with plans to transition our legacy .NET estate to new service\-based architectures. We're evolving towards a full\-stack engineering environment, with TypeScript, Node.js, React and AWS at the heart of our modern applications and services.


You'll contribute to modern cloud\-based solutions while also supporting established business\-critical applications as part of our ongoing technology modernisation programme.


This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys writing quality software, problem solving and continually developing their technical skills. **Key Responsibilities:**

* Participate in the ongoing modernisation of legacy systems and platforms.
* Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.

* REST APIs
* Event\-Driven Architecture

**About you**

You'll also:

* Take pride in delivering well\-thought\-out solutions.

* Ask questions, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and stay curious about better ways of doing things.
**Essential Skills**

* Strong coding skills using TypeScript, JavaScript or a comparable modern language.

**Desirable Skills**

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Engineer \- Investments**

**About Kota**


Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products \- Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution \- we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward\-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

 **The role \& team**


We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.


The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.


On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

 **What you'll do**

* Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer\-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
* Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
* Contribute to frontend code (React \+ TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
* Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
* Use AI actively in your day\-to\-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
* Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
* Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

 **What we're looking for**

* 6\+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
* Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs
* Strong understanding of data modelling, event\-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
* A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
* A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
* You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
* You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast\-growing startup
* AI\-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

 **Why join us?**

* **Technically interesting problem** \- pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised
* **Modern stack** \- .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event\-driven
* **Agency** \- we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
* **Customer proximity** \- you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
* **High\-quality culture** \- we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
* **Impact from day one** \- we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
* **AI\-first** \- we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

 **Our hiring process**

* **Introductory call (30 mins):** a casual chat with one or two of our product team
* **Technical interview (90 mins):** a collaborative, open\-book session with two engineers, working through a real\-world problem together
* **Call with founders (30 mins):** we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
* **Final response:** we'll follow up promptly with next steps

 **Kota benefits**

* Health insurance via Kota
* Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
* WFH stipend to support your home office setup
* Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
* Access to office space in Dublin or a co\-working space, wherever you're based
* Flexible working hours, we're remote\-first with some fixed hours for team alignment


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Nexio Management to około 550 konsultantów, którzy od ponad 20 lat tworzą zaawansowane rozwiązania IT dla firm w Polsce i za granicą. Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów, którzy realnie angażują się w projekty swoich klientów.
  

  

Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie \- dlatego mamy własne R\&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji.

-------------------


Poszukujemy Platform Engineera, który dołączy do zespołu budującego i rozwijającego nowoczesną, wysoce dostępną platformę infrastrukturalną on\-premises pod aplikacje biznesowe .NET. Szukamy inżyniera, który chce współtworzyć architekturę platformy od podstaw, wdrażać podejście GitOps i pracować z technologiami cloud\-native w środowisku on\-prem.

--------------------------


* Projektowanie, wdrażanie oraz utrzymanie klastrów Kubernetes (środowiska oparte o Talos Linux i wirtualizację Proxmox VE).

* Utrzymanie i rozwój platformy monitoringu opartej o OpenTelemetry oraz SigNoz.

* Min. 4 lata udokumentowanego doświadczenia w administracji systemami Linux.

* Praktyczna wiedza sieciowa: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, Reverse Proxy, Load Balancing.
* Umiejętność analitycznego diagnozowania problemów wydajnościowych i usuwania awarii produkcyjnych.
* Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego (poziom mi. B2\)

**Mile widziane**:


* Praktyka z Talos Linux oraz Proxmox VE.
* Praca z Terraform / OpenTofu lub Ansible.
* Doświadczenie ze środowiskami on\-premises o dużej skali.
* Certyfikaty inżynierskie: CKA, CKAD lub CKS.
**To oferujemy**
----------------


* Stabilność zatrudnienia \- długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT.
* Elastyczne formy współpracy \- umowa B2B, umowa o pracę lub zlecenie.
* Benefity: Medicover (rozszerzony o stomatologię), FitProfit, lekcje języka angielskiego.
* Treningi na siłowni F45 \- zlokalizowanej w naszym biurze. Wspólnie ćwiczymy pod okiem profesjonalnych trenerów.
* Wewnętrzny program poleceń.

* W zależności od projektu pracujemy w trybie hybrydowym, zdalnym lub stacjonarnym.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.

**What we're building**


We're building the data ingestion platform behind large\-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned\-system sensor networks and real\-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re\-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.

**How we build**


Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in\-process over distributed, shared\-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.


Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air\-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.

**You**


Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high\-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.


The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable\-sounding requests for one more special case.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why Join 4C Strategies**


If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi\-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual\-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.


The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior\-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

TRIOS Dx offers AI\-assisted dental diagnostic aid tools for monitoring oral health conditions and assessing changes in teeth and gingiva. By analyzing a 3D scan TRIOS Dx assists in diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque.

* Lead your team through the full product lifecycle \- from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on customer feedback.

* Proven experience with Machine Learning (e.g. deep neural networks, supervised and unsupervised learning), preferably within image processing or processing of 3D data

The mission is to design and deliver a comprehensive set of tools, services, and libraries that enable seamless interoperability of existing devices with both cloud and on-premises infrastructures. The focus is on ensuring data integrity, security, and interoperability across all systems.

Project Status

The project has successfully completed its high-level requirements definition and initial technical planning. The next stage involves detailed design, implementation, and verification & validation activities. Requirements

Exploratory Test Engineer combines two complementary responsibilities in a split role (Scrum Master 20‑40%, Exploratory Device Testing 60‑80%). As Scrum Master, the role serves primarily the RTD FrontEnd development team and may expand to cover the VideoUnit team (approx. 20% SM capacity per team). As Exploratory Test Engineer, the role performs hands-on testing directly on the NextGenRS Refractive Treatment Device hardware in a regulated medical device environment.

The RTD FrontEnd is a Windows x86-64 embedded system hosting multiple applications (FESupervisorApp, FEUserApp, FELogTransport, FemtoScan Service) that drive the full clinical workflow from patient selection through treatment execution. The VideoUnit is a Xilinx Zynq Ultrascale Linux system responsible for real-time image processing, eye tracking (SmartCam interface), and the Ophthalmic Digital Microscope. jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.
You test services and APIs directly, not through a user interface. REST and messaging, schemas and contracts are your natural working level.
You write test code, and you write it properly: readable, reviewed, running in a CI/CD pipeline. We work in C# on .NET with xUnit; another statically typed language is fine, and we give you the room to switch.
Hands-on with SQL and comfortable judging whether data and aggregations are actually correct.
A working understanding of distributed, service-based architectures: asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.
